name: weave_search_workspace
description: Searches the Weave workflows the user owns in their active workspace, most recently updated first; teammates' workflows aren't included. For Weave tools created from workflows, use weave_list_tools. Use it to find a workflow's id when the user names it, passing the name as `search`, so you can read or edit it with weave_get_workflow or weave_build_workflow. Skip it when you already have the id (pasted, or the `<id>` in an app.weavy.ai/flow/<id> URL). If several match, ask the user which one. If none match, say so; don't create a workflow or guess an id.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against workflow names, to find a workflow the user named. Omit it to get the 20 most recently updated workflows.
